AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Gardener
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Rather than the profound and philosophical genre of art,[PAWN_nameDef] prefers apparent beauty, so[PAWN_pronoun] fell in love with such a thing as raising flowers.Whenever spring comes,[PAWN_nameDef]'s home is always filled with the scent of fragrant flowers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Astronomy enthusiasts
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a veteran astronomy enthusiast,[PAWN_pronoun] is able to accurately point out common stars in the sky and on the chart, and knows all about them.In [PAWN_nameDef]'s eyes, the starry sky itself is the greatest work of art.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Migratory birds
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]Ray is one of the few citizens of the Oberonia aurea who is keen to work with animals,For this reason [PAWN_pronoun] even rented a house in the suburbs to get along with the birds.\nAnyone who lives in the suburbs knows that when winter is over, he will always sitting on the hillside waiting for the return of migratory birds.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Warmhearted traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Sometimes some people might worry that oberonia aurea's travelers will become eccentric because they have been out of society for a long time.Yet [PAWN_nameDef] is the best refutation of such doubts.Nature's rationality and indifference could not conquer [PAWN_nameDef] sensual and gentle soul, and [PAWN_nameDef] neither strangers nor companions would hesitate to lend a helping hand as long as they could.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assault forces paragon
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the paragon of Assault forces, and whether it's tactical maneuvers, squad collaboration, or field first aid,[PAWN_pronoun] has done quite well.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assault forces theorist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] always looks the classic combat cases in the galaxy on spare time,This makes [PAWN_pronoun] to have a unique understanding of military tactics and to be able to apply what they have learned in combat.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assault forces maintainer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Before signing up for the Assault forces,[PAWN_nameDef] Was a good craftsman.Now, [PAWN_pronoun] applies this craft to daily weapons maintenance to ensure that the weapons of [PAWN_pronoun] and [PAWN_pronoun] comrades do not fail at critical moments.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Straight assault forces
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] lacks the tolerance and empathy as a Oberonia aureain.Compared to other Oberonia aurea citizens,[PAWN_nameDef] will always point out the mistakes and shortcomings of the other party straightforwardness.This makes [PAWN_pronoun] social interaction always not too smoothly,until [PAWN_pronoun] joined the assault forces.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cautious squad leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has always had a reverence for war. [PAWN_pronoun] understand that for war the death of a soldier is really insignificant,This prompts [PAWN_pronoun] to always make decisions after thorough consideration in combat missions and often try the best to minimize losses.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Conscientious paramedic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a paramedic with a strong sense of mission.For [PAWN_nameDef], the lives of a companion are enough to make [PAWN_pronoun] forget about the potential danger.This makes [PAWN_nameDef] to treat the wounded without distraction, even in a combat zone.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Experienced paramedic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has received many years of systematic training as a doctor in the Imperial Health Department. After that, he joined the assault force

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Trader in journey
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: As a trader,[PAWN_nameDef] are not keen on trade, but prefer to personally taste the local specialties and then promote their dissemination.It is difficult for others to understand why [PAWN_nameDef] does not pursue career success, and perhaps only [PAWN_nameDef] himself knows which is the [PAWN_pronoun] pursuit, travel or trade.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Mountaineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is passionate about trying to challenge a wide variety of mountains and dangerous peaks.Although there are times when there are life-threatening risks, [PAWN_nameDef] still loves the cause and enjoys the joy and improvement that comes with each success.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Strict squad leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Although they are not a front-line combat unit, [PAWN_nameDef] still maintains a relatively strict training for the escort team he leads.[PAWN_nameDef] argues that even if these trainings prove unnecessary in the end, once they are put to use, it will be possible for more people to survive.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Acclaimed squad leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] knows how to balance firmness and gentleness in military training. [PAWN_nameDef] rarely engages in excessive obedience training but instead, in most cases, adopts reasonable and humane technical training methods, making [PAWN_pronoun] quite popular.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·An attendants who has participated in disaster relief
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] once participated in a disaster relief effort in a city that was severely damaged by a sudden catastrophe. The cries of the victims left a deep impression on [PAWN_nameDef] at that time, which makes [PAWN_pronoun] now more enthusiastic about first aid and rescue training in the guard.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Sharpshooter of the guard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has an exceptional talent for shooting. Whenever the guard conducts shooting training, [PAWN_pronoun] often ends up with the best results.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Military fan attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] usually has a strong interest in firearms and other weapons, and after joining the guard, this interest has been fully satisfied. When others are exhausted from training, [PAWN_pronoun] still has plenty of energy.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Technical department attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the technical department in the Golden Iris Court. In the daily operations of this vast court, [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of precision instruments and providing technical support on instruments to other departments.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Industry Attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the industrial department in the Golden Iris Court. Whenever buildings need planning and repairs, large industrial machinery requires operation, or daily production machinery malfunctions, [PAWN_nameDef] understands that it's their time to act. For [PAWN_nameDef], there's a unique romance in these large engineering machines.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Technical department manager
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Manager does not need to personally handle the tuning of precision machinery like the front-line technical attendants. Most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef] needs to first manage a series of general affairs in the technology department and coordinate with other court departments. Only after these tasks are completed can [PAWN_nameDef] find the time to enjoy the company of machinery.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Technical officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] possesses exceptional professional skills. Whether it's maintenance, testing, research and development, or operation, these tasks are easily handled by [PAWN_nameDef]. This ability naturally led to [PAWN_pronoun] being promoted to the position of technical officer.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Industry manager
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is in charge of the overall management of the court's industrial department. On a daily basis, [PAWN_nameDef] is primarily engaged with a continuous stream of production reports and reports on industrial machinery, making it increasingly difficult for [PAWN_pronoun] to spend time with the machinery that [PAWN_pronoun] loves.\n\nHowever, once [PAWN_nameDef] personally engages in engineering design or machinery operation, the level of technical skill [PAWN_pronoun] demonstrates is enough to impress everyone.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Indifferently traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does not like to compete, nor does [PAWN_pronoun] wish to conquer just for the sake of conquering. While others focus on reaching the summit and climb upwards, [PAWN_nameDef] often pauses to appreciate the beauty around [PAWN_pronoun]. For [PAWN_nameDef], this is the right way to travel.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Wilderness traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does not favor towering mountains, but prefers the boundless wilderness. Therefore, whenever [PAWN_pronoun] travels, [PAWN_nameDef] deliberately chooses flat destinations, avoiding mountainous areas. This selective approach to travel has endowed [PAWN_nameDef] with excellent wilderness survival skills, yet [PAWN_pronoun] has little knowledge of mountainous terrain.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cavern traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is fascinated by the unpredictable mountain caves, with their bizarre internal structures and the variety of strange rocks that always leave [PAWN_pronoun] in awe. Through these repeated cave adventures, [PAWN_nameDef] has accumulated mountain and cave knowledge far beyond the ordinary, making [PAWN_pronoun] a true master of the mountains.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Polar traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The Oberonia Aurea originated on a polar planet, and such unique geographical conditions have given rise to a large group of enthusiasts passionate about polar exploration, with [PAWN_nameDef] being one of them. Compared to conventional exploration, polar exploration requires facing more severe conditions, demands more specialized knowledge, and a resilient will. Fortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] possesses all of these qualities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Construction engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the member of court's industrial department. Due to [PAWN_pronoun] expertise in construction machinery, [PAWN_pronoun] spends most of the time operating and directing construction machinery to build new structures.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Heavy machinery maintainer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the member of court's industrial department.[PAWN_pronoun]'s daily task is to take care of the large industrial machinery and perform the necessary maintenance work on them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Chatterbox of industrial department
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Most people think that the attendants of the industrial department are generally serious, composed, and resolute, but [PAWN_nameDef] is not like that at all. Every attendant in the industrial department knows that it's best not to engage [PAWN_nameDef] in conversation during work, otherwise, they will definitely be distracted by [PAWN_pronoun]'s incessant talking.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Survived attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Although the Oberonia Aurea industrial equipment has elevated safety to extremely high standards, minor accidents still occur occasionally, and [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the victims of such accidents. Although [PAWN_pronoun] did not lose [PAWN_pronoun] life in that incident, the harrowing accident still left a significant shadow on [PAWN_nameDef].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Model of industry
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] can be described as the epitome of an attendant in the industrial department. From any perspective, [PAWN_pronoun] fits the stereotype of an industrial department attendant perfectly whether it's [PAWN_pronoun]'s proficient skills, concise demeanor, or stubborn temperament.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Edle in court
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was once a diligent attendant in the court department. This diligence led [PAWN_pronoun] to make outstanding contributions on the job multiple times, and eventually earned [PAWN_pronoun] the status of an honorary edle.\nUnlike most people, after becoming a noble, [PAWN_nameDef] still chose to remain in the court. For [PAWN_pronoun], dedicating oneself for the sake of others is a highly honorable pursuit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Coordination department attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: department, [PAWN_pronoun] deals with large amounts of data on a daily basis. Although it is hard to make outstanding contributions in this job, no one doubts its importance.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Animal sanctuary monitor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Department of Natural Biology and Environment in the court. [PAWN_pronoun]'s daily work involves assessing the ecological condition of animal sanctuaries through data and imagery. At the end of a day's work, [PAWN_pronoun] also occasionally takes walks within the jurisdiction, enjoying the time spent close to the animals.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Health supervisor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a member of the Medical Care Department in the court, responsible for guiding the daily lives of patients. Whether the patients are in the hospital beds of the Medical Care Department or recuperating at home, [PAWN_nameDef] always appears by their bedsides on time and without fail.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Model worker of industry
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] loves the sound of heavy machinery at work; to [PAWN_pronoun], this industrial noise is the most beautiful melody in the world. This passion ultimately led to [PAWN_pronoun] being among the most efficient workers in the industrial department.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Gear maker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: In the industrial department, [PAWN_nameDef] is primarily responsible for the manufacturing of industrial machinery parts, testing, and quality control of the final products. [PAWN_nameDef] understands that even the largest machinery is driven by numerous small gears.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Accurately attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s work style is not like the traditional attendants in the industrial department, but rather more akin to those in the neighboring technical department. While others often experience fluctuations in work efficiency due to various issues, [PAWN_nameDef] is able to maintain a consistent pace, performing just as well as before without any deviation.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Pastry chef
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] devotes the majority of [PAWN_pronoun] energy to researching new pastries and has achieved considerable success. Through prolonged effort and study, the pastries [PAWN_pronoun] creates are not only delicious but also very aesthetically pleasing.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Fiction writer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has published several serialized novels in local literary magazines. While not hugely popular, [PAWN_nameDef] has garnered a significant readership. Now, in search of new inspiration and after much deliberation, [PAWN_pronoun] has chosen to come to the Milky Way.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Artistic citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does not believe that art must have a specific form, but rather sees art as existing in the everyday life around us. In [PAWN_nameDef]'s eyes, if one is mindful, everything around can provide different artistic inspirations.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Letter liked citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does not enjoy a fast-paced lifestyle, so [PAWN_pronoun] rarely uses instant online communication and prefers to communicate through letters instead. These letters are slow to arrive, but they also slow down [PAWN_nameDef]'s life.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Classical drama actor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is an exceptionally talented classical theater actor. [PAWN_pronoun]'s excellent character design and impeccable acting skills have earned [PAWN_pronoun] a large following of loyal audience members.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Hurried attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Time and again, the colleagues in the industrial department have grown accustomed to it. They know it's not due to diligence, but because [PAWN_nameDef] has messed up again. Perhaps because of a poor memory or other reasons, [PAWN_nameDef] always seems to have issues with details, which leads [PAWN_pronoun] to frequently run around putting out fires to fix the troubles [PAWN_pronoun] has caused.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Wounded assaulter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was injured during a raid. While on the hospital bed, [PAWN_nameDef] did not succumb to the pain of the injury or the solitude of being away from the team. Instead, [PAWN_pronoun] strengthened [PAWN_pronoun]'s resolve to protect [PAWN_pronoun]'s comrades and to intensify training, which ultimately made [PAWN_pronoun] return to the team with more energy and enthusiasm than ever before.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court beautifier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for the beautification and daily cleaning of the palace's interior in the court department, to maintain the palace's aesthetics and boost the morale of other attendants.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Excellent court officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] performs exceptionally well in the court department. [PAWN_pronoun] always manages to identify the most critical aspects among a plethora of complex issues and resolves them efficiently. Ultimately, this outstanding performance was recognized by the head of the court department, who promoted [PAWN_pronoun] to one of the court officers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Court chef
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for the dietary and living arrangements of many individuals in the court. No matter what the dietary requirements are, [PAWN_nameDef] handles the cooking with ease.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Master of horror stories
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Even though technology has advanced enough to solve most mysteries, the citizens of the Oberonia Aurea still enjoy eerie and incomprehensible horror stories. Whenever a gathering reaches its midpoint, [PAWN_nameDef], always under the eager anticipation of everyone, vividly begins [PAWN_pronoun]'s performance.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Researcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is passionate about learning new knowledge, whether it be literary classics or scientific formulas. All of these can immerse [PAWN_nameDef] completely.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Sleepless scholar
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is always in pursuit of new knowledge, sometimes even forgetting to eat while persisting in reading at the library. Although this behavior has endowed [PAWN_nameDef] with knowledge far beyond the ordinary, it has also taken a toll on [PAWN_pronoun]'s health.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Herbarium maker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys creating specimens from various plants, and for this reason, [PAWN_pronoun] often goes to the countryside to collect naturally growing plants. Although the process is tiring, [PAWN_nameDef] always feels an indescribable sense of satisfaction the moment the specimen is completed and time is preserved.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Lineman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: If anyone knows the community's network of lines like the back of their hand, that person would undoubtedly be [PAWN_nameDef]. As a technician in the technical department, [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for maintaining all kinds of lines throughout the community. This requires not only good professional skills but also remarkable memory and excellent logical reasoning abilities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Sharp traveler
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does not have very good physical fitness, which makes the already dangerous journeys even more perilous for [PAWN_pronoun]. However, [PAWN_nameDef] has [PAWN_pronoun] own strategies if [PAWN_pronoun] can avoid risks through keen observation and excellent knowledge, then the disadvantage of physical fitness won't cause too much trouble.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Tea picker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Drinking tea is a very common pastime among the citizens of Golden Iris. Most citizens brew tea with the common Golden Iris flower, but [PAWN_nameDef] believes that there must be better tea leaves out there. For this reason, [PAWN_nameDef] has traveled across multiple planets, and it is foreseeable that [PAWN_nameDef] will continue to do so until finding the perfect tea leaf in [PAWN_pronoun] heart.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Electrician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] achieved remarkably outstanding results in the electrical courses at the technical department, and naturally became an electrician in the technical department after the training concluded. [PAWN_pronoun] specifically handles matters related to electrical equipment.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Micromechanical Administrator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Big does not necessarily mean good, and more does not necessarily mean beautiful. No matter how others view this statement, [PAWN_nameDef] is utterly convinced of its truth, which fills [PAWN_pronoun] with enthusiasm and vitality in [PAWN_pronoun]'s daily management of micro-mechanics.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Troubleshooter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: To become an excellent troubleshooter often requires outstanding logical reasoning skills, a solid theoretical foundation, and a bit of luck fortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] possesses all of these. Therefore, when the regular staff in the technical department encounter malfunctions that are incomprehensible and the cause cannot be found, it is often [PAWN_nameDef]'s time to shine.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Failure Preventer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The ultimate goal of the technical department is to eliminate the term "mechanical failure" from daily life, and achieving this is not only through repair but also prevention. To realize this goal, [PAWN_nameDef] is always inspecting various devices and uses known information to make judgments to prevent potential failures.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Instrument regulators
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: If it weren't for the uniform proving his affiliation, [PAWN_nameDef]'s usual work might even make one think he belongs to the coordination department rather than the technical department. Unlike colleagues who are busy running in the hallways or working at research stations, [PAWN_nameDef] spends more time battling with documents and using his sharp intuition to preempt potential management issues.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Researcher of new theory
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Just like the instrument regulators next door, the role of a new theory researcher is also one that can easily be misattributed. After all, in most people's understanding, research activities are expected to belong to the research department, not the technical department. However, expertise varies by field, and even the top researchers in the research department might not have more insight into technical structural theory than [PAWN_nameDef]. As a theoretical researcher in the technical department, serving as a bridge and communicator between theory and practice, [PAWN_nameDef] is undoubtedly well-qualified.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Test pilot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: A new device often needs to be tested before it can be mass-produced, and most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for this testing. As a test pilot, [PAWN_nameDef] not only faces potential risks but also has to consider the device's various elements and environmental impacts holistically. This high-intensity work environment has ultimately honed [PAWN_nameDef]'s technical skills to a very high level.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Meticulous attendants
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is skilled at detecting potential issues from minor details. Any anomaly in the equipment, even a slight problem, catches [PAWN_nameDef]'s attention, and [PAWN_pronoun] ultimately tunes it to perfect operation. This meticulous attitude has helped [PAWN_nameDef] resolve numerous potential equipment failures and continuously strengthens [PAWN_pronoun]'s technical abilities and patience.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Troubleshooter attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: In every department, there are a few people who just can't seem to sit still, and in the technical department, that person is undoubtedly [PAWN_nameDef]. When others are having tea, [PAWN_nameDef] is fixing equipment. When others are chatting, [PAWN_nameDef] is repairing devices. Even just passing by an ordinary room, [PAWN_nameDef] might be pulled in to fix something.\nLong-term busyness has become the norm for [PAWN_nameDef]. Now, if there comes a day when [PAWN_pronoun] has nothing to do, [PAWN_pronoun] would actually feel out of place.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Lazy technicians
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The open and liberal atmosphere of the technical department has always been under scrutiny, and [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the reasons for this skepticism. Most of the time, [PAWN_nameDef] is not fully focused on [PAWN_pronoun] duties, but instead always looking for ways to slack off. Although, relatively speaking, the attendants of the technical department are not considered diligent, [PAWN_nameDef]'s level of slacking still far exceeds that of [PAWN_pronoun] colleagues.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Community Troubleshooter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Although [PAWN_nameDef] spends most of the time moving around the community, [PAWN_pronoun] is indeed a bona fide attendant of the technical department. The duties of a community troubleshooter require [PAWN_nameDef] to mostly patrol and be on standby within the community, rather than staying inside the palace like [PAWN_pronoun] colleagues.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Meticulous technical officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Attentive and cautious are the best words to describe [PAWN_nameDef]. During [PAWN_pronoun] more than ten years in the technical department, these traits have successfully helped [PAWN_nameDef] avoid or resolve several catastrophic failures. Ultimately, these contributions led [PAWN_nameDef] to become one of the technical officers in the department.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Tinkering citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: On most days, [PAWN_nameDef] rarely goes out, preferring to stay at home tinkering with odd yet practical little inventions. While these creations might seem crude or inadequate to professionals, [PAWN_nameDef] thoroughly enjoys making them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Snow sculptor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: For [PAWN_nameDef], there is no need to deliberately search for materials for sculpture; the readily available ice and snow are the best raw materials for artworks. After each heavy snowfall, [PAWN_nameDef] constructs snow sculptures in the square for passersby to admire.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Petrologist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Unlike sculptors, [PAWN_nameDef] simply loves various kinds of stones. Those with bizarre and fascinating patterns always captivate [PAWN_nameDef], driving [PAWN_nameDef] further along the path of geology and rock studies.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Sunset Recorder
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: "The setting sun is endlessly beautiful, it's just that dusk is near."\n[PAWN_nameDef] lingers in the breathtaking sunset and is determined to preserve it forever. Every day, [PAWN_nameDef] looks forward to the sunset at dusk, searching for new angles and photographic techniques to capture each day's sunset, ultimately sealing them in their photo album.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Furniture repairer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Past court training and subsequent self-study endowed [PAWN_nameDef] with excellent craftsmanship. When neighbors encounter furniture problems, their first thought often isn't to report it to the community but to see if [PAWN_nameDef] can fix it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Peaceful citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] hardly ever gets into conflicts with anyone. When others are arguing, [PAWN_nameDef] simply stays silent on the side, waiting for the dispute to end before separately consoling both parties. While some might see this behavior as fence-sitting, [PAWN_nameDef] believes that everyone getting along harmoniously is more important than anything else.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Forgetful citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] always tends to forget things, whether its a tap left running or small items misplaced; these are prime examples of [PAWN_nameDef]'s poor memory. However, a bad memory isn't only a disadvantage. For instance, when encountering unpleasant situations, [PAWN_nameDef] often quickly forgets about them, which might be considered a blessing in disguise.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Fabric worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Complex clothing design is not [PAWN_nameDef]'s forte. Compared to garment design, [PAWN_nameDef] prefers experimenting with new fabrics and creating simple yet elegant patterns on them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Personal attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Not everyone in the court staff can become a personal attendant, but [PAWN_nameDef] succeeded in securing this position with their outstanding abilities. In most cases, [PAWN_nameDef] understands the needs and commands of the nobles they serve and completes them efficiently.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Tea ceremony attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: If it comes to work efficiency, [PAWN_nameDef] may not be outstanding, but in terms of tea art, [PAWN_nameDef] would certainly be first-rate. Although [PAWN_nameDef] has not deliberately honed their tea-making skills, a long-standing passion has elevated their expertise to a high level. As a result, one of the most common activities for the attendants in their spare time is to invite [PAWN_nameDef] to host a tea party.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Emergency operator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Even in the most developed and comfortable societies, someone always has to bear certain burdens, and [PAWN_nameDef] understands this principle. Therefore, while other citizens relax in their daily lives, [PAWN_nameDef] needs to be constantly seated at the communications console, waiting for possible distress calls and ready to respond at any moment.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Psychologist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has encountered patients with various psychological issues, including nobles overwhelmed by the pressures of cumbersome duties and citizens who suffer heartbreak due to social maladjustment. Ultimately, [PAWN_nameDef] has successfully helped them overcome these pains. Achieving this requires not only professional knowledge but also empathy, tenderness, and care.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Night physician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Unlike those with regular schedules, the onset of illnesses doesn't follow a routine, so night physicians are sometimes even busier than day physicians. Fortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] is well-suited to all this. After all, for night owls, there's no time more delightful than the nighttime.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Trimmed crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Every interstellar journey is fraught with risks, so after a voyage ends, the captain of the Oberonia Aurea often grants the crew a long vacation to alleviate their mental stress.\nThe cargo ship [PAWN_nameDef] is on has just completed a supply transport to a new colony. Before the next departure, [PAWN_nameDef] plans to explore as much as possible in this brand-new star system to relax.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Animal lovers
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] believes that all creatures possess unique abilities and the right to live. Therefore, as long as it does not cause inconvenience, [PAWN_nameDef] always keeps some small animals and tries to share the unique aspects of these wonderful

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Plant researcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The development of agriculture requires not only advancements in cultivation techniques but also the evolution of plant varieties. For the progress of plant science, [PAWN_nameDef] voluntarily gave up the comfortable laboratory in the technology department and went into the wild, filled with weeds and mosquitoes, to explore new possibilities.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Patient florist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: People who know [PAWN_nameDef] are aware that [PAWN_nameDef] is a very patient gardener. She doesn't get upset over a wilting plant; instead, she consults resources, changes her care approach, and continues her daily maintenance as usual. Although many plants ultimately perish, [PAWN_nameDef] always feels genuinely happy whenever a flower blooms for the second time.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Excellent attacker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: It may be due to great skill and courage, or perhaps irrational heroism, but when a combat mission requires someone to lead the breakthrough, [PAWN_nameDef] is often the most eager to step up. In most cases, [PAWN_nameDef] indeed proves to be an excellent vanguard.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·All-round player
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Whether it's urban warfare or field battles, whether it involves submachine guns or launchers, there is no form of combat that [PAWN_nameDef] cannot adapt to. While others are still slowed down by environmental factors, [PAWN_nameDef] has already figured out what needs to be done.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assault forces tactician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: The squad leaders in a Assault force often have unique strengths. Some excel at individual breakthroughs, others at overseeing the entire situation. For [PAWN_nameDef], his specialty is small-scale command. In minor conflicts, [PAWN_nameDef] can often make the most rational commands and arrangements, and quickly find the breakthrough point in the battle.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·A mother-lost child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Before [PAWN_nameDef] had the ability to live independently, his mother tragically died in a raid operation. Although [PAWN_nameDef] understands that sacrifice is a normal part of being a soldier, the profound

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Children in see of flowers
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] loves the feeling of lying in a sea of flowers. The swaying irises, the fluttering butterflies, and the faint scent of flowers make up the most beautiful tableau of [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Little poet
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: From a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] possessed an exceptional literary talent. While other children were still puzzled by writing, [PAWN_nameDef] could already recite beautifully rhythmic verses off the cuff. Although this talent brought him the envy and praise of others, it also filled his young mind with worries and sadness that were beyond his years.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Machinery-curious kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: From a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] was fascinated by intricate machinery. When his parents noticed his interest, they immediately bought him a vast array of related books and educational materials to nurture his mechanical talent and rational thinking skills.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Rebellious kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Saying east and going west, being told to go south and heading north, [PAWN_nameDef] was never an obedient child. His young mind was filled with a longing for freedom and a disdain for being controlled by others. All of this caused considerable headaches for his parents and tutors, who expended a lot of energy in educating him.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Thoughtful child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Everyone who has interacted with [PAWN_nameDef] inevitably praises his thoughtfulness. [PAWN_nameDef] seems to possess a talent for sensing what others are thinking and feeling, which allows him to always provide what people need or help them precisely when it is required.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child born in snow
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born during a blizzard that nearly swept through the entire city. Perhaps influenced by that storm, [PAWN_nameDef] has an inexplicable fondness for snow and wind. Whenever it snows, [PAWN_nameDef] always makes a point to step outside and quietly savor the sensation of snowflakes falling on him.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Excellent physique child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] contracted several severe childhood diseases in succession and nearly died from them. Fortunately, the advanced medical technology of Golden Iris ultimately saved the critically ill [PAWN_nameDef]. Later, perhaps due to the development of antibodies or other reasons, [PAWN_nameDef]'s immunity seems to be much stronger than that of his peers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Paint disc destroyer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was once considered a well-behaved child in the eyes of his parents, until one day they came home to find the easel in the study knocked over, with colorful paints smeared all over the room.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Serious child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has always struggled to understand why mistakes can be forgiven. In his young mind, right is right and wrong is wrong, with no room for ambiguity. This leads [PAWN_nameDef] to always point out others' faults directly, without regard for their feelings.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Math-loved kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys the complex relationships between numbers and is always looking for mathematical connections in everyday life. This sensitivity to numbers not only makes [PAWN_nameDef] excel in math classes but also allows him to discern some patterns in business.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Assertive children
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: From the time [PAWN_nameDef] began to form memories, his parents deliberately cultivated his ability to be independent and make his own decisions. This upbringing ensured that even though [PAWN_nameDef] was still physically a child, psychologically he was far more mature than his peers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Small tester
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood could be described as imperfectly happy. Although he indeed had parents who loved him dearly, the food they cooked was quite the opposite of this love. For [PAWN_nameDef], the news he most looked forward to hearing as a child was not about going on a trip, but that they were ordering takeout for the day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child at sunset
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Whenever the sun sets, [PAWN_nameDef] always sits alone on the edge of the roof, gazing thoughtfully at the distant sunset. Most people don't understand the significance of this for [PAWN_nameDef], only he knows the thoughts he entrusts to the setting sun.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Child on the hillside
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a city with slightly undulating terrain. When his parents were not at home, [PAWN_nameDef] would occasionally sneak off to a small hill on the outskirts of the city and then spend the whole day playing leisurely on the hillside.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Little mediator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: When the children around him were arguing over a trivial matter, [PAWN_nameDef] would always arrive in time to intervene and mediate the dispute. In most cases, his mediation would satisfy both parties, but occasionally some would not listen to reason. In such instances, [PAWN_nameDef] would resort to physical means to drive the point home.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Spoiled child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was undoubtedly quite happy, with his parents' endless pampering allowing him to have a carefree and stress-free upbringing. However, this spoon-fed lifestyle resulted in [PAWN_nameDef] having poorer self-care abilities compared to others, and his ability to handle stress was also significantly less than that of his peers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Jade loved kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is easily distracted by shiny objects. When he was young, he often showed a keen interest in sparkling emeralds and other translucent stones. To a child's eyes, these stones, glowing with vibrant colors, were simply the most beautiful things in the world.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Little encyclopedia
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] loved spending time in the library, where years of reading provided him with a rich reservoir of knowledge. Therefore, when others asked [PAWN_nameDef] about common sense facts or scientific theories, he could often respond fluently and informatively.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cook poring Citizen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: In the free time, [PAWN_nameDef] always likes to retreat to the kitchen and experiment with odd ingredients to make unusual dishes. Although most of these creations end up in the trash, [PAWN_nameDef] remains undeterred and continues to enthusiastically set new records in producing kitchen waste.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Logistics statistician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] works in the logistics department of the local court. As a logistics coordinator, [PAWN_nameDef]'s daily routine involves interfacing with numerous space merchant ships or other court supply vessels to ensure the smooth operation of the extensive logistics network of Golden Iris.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Interstellar logistician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: As one of the few attendants required to travel between stars, [PAWN_nameDef]'s daily treatment and benefits can be described as quite generous.\n\nAfter all, if a person has to undertake a journey lasting a year or even several years every few months, and also has to face the complex and varied risks of the universe, then it is only right that their compensation is relatively generous.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Firearms technician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Unlike his colleagues in the technical department, [PAWN_nameDef] rarely handles daily equipment management. Instead, he spends more time with members of the Assault force, providing technical support for their equipment. His prolonged interaction with military personnel has also taught [PAWN_nameDef] some combat knowledge.
